label: Hitron CODA6021 DOCSIS 4.0 cable gateway
description: DOCSIS 4.0 gateway with 5 configurable OFDM and 7 OFDMA channels plus 32x8 DOCSIS 3.0 fallback, tri-band Wi-Fi 7, and two 10GBASE-T plus two 2.5GBASE-T LAN ports.
notes: Datasheet: 'DOCSIS 4.0 5x7 OFDM/OFDMA', 'DOCSIS 3.0 32x8 Channel Bonding', switchable upstream 5-85 / 5-204 / 5-85 + 108-396 MHz, downstream up to 1794 MHz, and interfaces '1 x RF F-Type 75 ohm female', '2 x RJ-45 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G BASE-T', '2 x RJ-45 100M/1G/2.5G BASE-T'. Wi-Fi 7 is 4x4 on 2.4/5/6 GHz; wireless speeds here are per-band 4x4 802.11be (40/160/320 MHz) approximations. Voice-capable gateway, so its RJ11 FXS jacks are omitted. This is the only DOCSIS 4.0 CPE I could verify from a vendor datasheet, and it ships as a gateway rather than a bare modem.
